# Skate Day
1) Wide establishing shot: an empty concrete skatepark at golden hour.
2) Rio drops in on the big bowl — fpv camera chasing right behind her wheels.
3) She bails hard. Crash zoom on her face as she laughs it off.
4) Sam rolls over and offers a hand. "You good?" Rio: "Never better."
5) Both of them sit on the ledge, sharing a soda. Static, hold for three seconds.
6) Crane up and away as the lights of the city come on behind them.
